name: theme-newspaper
docs: FONTS (required): add to your HTML <head> — CSS @import breaks Vite/lightningcss. <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Old+Standard+TT:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Libre+Baskerville:wght@400;500;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap">. Then wrap your app root in class="theme-newspaper" (add sf-enforce if the app bakes font/shadow literals).
title: Newspaper
description: Newspaper — newsprint gray, blackletter-ish serif heads, column rules — fonts via <link> (see docs), full app-variable bridge (shadcn + sidebar + charts + font/shadow scales). Wrap your app root in class "theme-newspaper".
